scope: Correction to the public edition. Restores seven working files that included certificate programs read or import and that the edition had omitted, so the packet census and the listed separate implementations run from a fresh copy. Adds the census to the reproduction guide and to the automatic checks. No theorem, proof text, paper source, PDF or previously included certificate or data file is changed.
prepared_by: Claude (Anthropic), at the author's request. This is a packaging correction, not a mathematical review, and it adopts no claim.
restored_files_note: Each restored file is byte-identical to an object already recorded by SHA256 and size in evidence/index.json. The object store and that index are unchanged; the files are restored at their working paths only.

claim_reference_updates.change: direct_evidence entries for the restored files now read INCLUDED with a locator

not_restored: certificates/principal_quotient_models_v162.jsonl and certificates/principal_quotient_periods_v162.jsonl remain omitted; no included program reads them.
checks_scope: Each command exited 0 on Linux x86_64 with Python 3.14.6; the two census commands also on Python 3.9, 3.12 and 3.13. These are packaging and exact-arithmetic regressions. They do not replay the geometric exclusion searches.
